notes.title: New 2025 Platypus Reclayed Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
The wait is over - Download the demo NOW and prepare for battle! 🛸💥🛸 


From June 9-16th | Experience claytastic arcade style mayhem with engrossing retro vibes - The cult shoot-em-up Platypus is back in all its clayful glory. 👏


Platypus Reclayed is a remake from the original creator Anthony Flack - Find the new Steam demo here:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912430/Platypus_Reclayed/"][/dynamiclink]

Steam Next Fest Demo Highlights:

🕹️ Casual arcade shooting mayhem

🚀 New ships and weapons

🎶 Engrossing soundtrack with an irresistible retro vibe

🎨 Fully clay-animated visuals (fingerprints included)

🧡 Couch co-op
